run_detr_training: run the DETR training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
run_detr_evaluation: run the DETR model in eval-only mode to test on a dataset using saved weights
build_optimizer_detr: build an SGD or AdamW optimizer with gradient clipping and backbone learning rate multiplier for DETR
build_train_loader_detr: build a detection training data loader using the DetrDatasetMapper for DETR model training
build_evaluator_detr: build a COCOEvaluator for evaluating DETR model predictions on a given dataset
